notes.title: Death Noodle Delivery is Coming to Consoles This July 31st!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have some great news for you today!

Death Noodle Delivery is expanding its delivery radius and will soon be able to reach folks hungry for noodles on XBOX X|S, PLAYSTATION 4, PLAYSTATION 5, AND NINTENDO SWITCH!

Since our launch on Steam, we've been pleased by the positive reception from players and critics alike. Your support and feedback have been invaluable, and we’re excited for folks to enjoy Death Noodle Delivery in even more ways.


We’re also pleased to reveal that DND will be on a 33% off sale from now until August 12th!

Lastly, we want to thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Seeing Death Noodle Delivery on consoles makes us really happy, and we’re glad to enjoy this next step in our indie dev journey with you.

Catch you on our mean streets,

Your fellow game devs,

Stefano & Fabio

[*] Fixed a bug in the highway chase levels for the cat bomb: now it's easier to destroy enemy cars.
[*] Fixed difficulty of some game level, especially the last one (now easier)

Should you find any bugs, do not hesitate to contact us or to write on the official discussion!

As always, thank you for your support! We hope you'll have a good time in Death Noodle Delivery!

Yours fellow gamedevs,

notes.title: The Scorecards are in: Take a look at some of the press reviews for Death Noodle
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

It’s almost been a week since Death Noodle Delivery has launched on Steam and we are grateful to everyone who has purchased a copy of the game, and even more to those who have left their review (this helps us a lot!).

When it comes to reviews from press, journalists globally did not shy away from trying Death Noodle Delivery and leaving their thoughts on a variety of articles, which we want to share with you below, in case you were still on the fence about grabbing your own copy, we hope these articles give you a glimpse at what Death Noodle Delivery is all about:

A tragically effective and realistic cyberpunk narrative
Multiplayer (7.5/10)
https://multiplayer.it/recensioni/death-noodle-delivery-recensione.html

notes.title: Death Noodle Delivery is OUT NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Today is the day!

[h2]Death Noodle Delivery is officially available for purchase right here on Steam![/h2]

This is our first project as two solo-developers (Tiny Pixel and Stupidi Pixel) who have joined forces to make projects that we love, and that we hope you will play and enjoy. 

Death Noodle Delivery is an often surreal and gritty, cyberpunk narrative-action game which imagines the life of a food delivery driver in a dark futuristic world, where society is on the brink of collapse, a new crisis happens every day, and where dangers lurk in every corner. 

You’ll take on the role of Jimmy as he starts his new job, delivering noodles for a big corporation that pays you only if you survive. Most citizens in this city spend their entire lives looking to earn cash and seeking leisure within the walls of their apartments, connected to cyberspace, seeking to quench their thirst in all kinds of pleasures, from Sex AIs to very strong drugs, Jimmy’s world is not for those who love sunflowers and rainbows!

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[b]Ride through a cyberpunk city on the brink of collapse:[/b]
Deliver your boss’ noodles escaping dangers like AI drones and bad drivers
Learn the best tactics to survive each delivery ride and get home in one piece

[b]Upgrade your hoverboard from a rusty ironing board to a powerful machine:[/b]
Jailbreak AI to unlock new power-ups
Utilize AI simulations to practice deliveries and test new board features

[b]Interact with neighbors to uncover their hidden stories:[/b]
Meet the folks living in your apartment and form relationships
Explore the web for hacks and pleasures

The game is available for purchase today for the price of $4.99 on Steam for PC with a discount of 15%, so grab it right now!

 The OST DLC will launch a little later for $1.99. 

If you are also a console player, or know someone with a Nintendo Switch, Xbox or PlayStation who might enjoy Death Noodle Delivery, it will come to those consoles very soon!

Thank you for stopping by. 

If you would like to join us in further discussion, want to tell us your deepest AI-xieties, or drop us a follow, just write us here on our pages on social platforms!

Thank you for your support!!

Stefano & Fabio

notes.title: Death Noodle Delivery has a date for PC Launch, and it's soon!
notes.notes:
It’s almost time to practice your hoverboarding skills and learn a thing or two about jailbreaking AI, as ourselves and Troglobytes Games are incredibly excited to reveal Death Noodle Delivery will launch on Steam for PC [b]this April 4th![/b]

You can watch the teaser trailer below now:

[previewyoutube=pBZSUna-Kaw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have been following us for a while, have already tried out the demo or have just finished watching our teaser trailer above, you’ll know our game will be filled with greasy pan-fried noodles, mind-altering substances and very glitchy AI. We were also inspired by the 1985 Atari action-arcade classic, Paperboy.

Death Noodle Delivery proposes a blend of fast-paced action and storytelling, allowing you to uncover the game world's secrets as you progress through the seven-day survival challenge. From engaging in conversations with quirky neighbors to scouring the web for hacks and hidden pleasures, let yourself delve deep into the heart of this cyberpunk metropolis. 

Remember, the game will initially release on Steam for PC on April 4th, 2024. Console players can rest assured that the game will make its way to other platforms soon, including Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation, later in the year. 

Turkish joins the list of languages we already announced in a past Steam update, so the game will launch in English, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Turkish.

So, what are you waiting for? Wishlist the game If you haven't done it yet, and prepare yourself for a hell of a ride!!

Thank you all for your support!

Stefano & Fabio

notes.title: Development News and special Thanks
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Chooms![/h2]

First of all: [b]Thank you to all of you for wishlisting the game![/b] Since Steam Next Fest we have been busy in the development of the game and participating to conventions to  show the game.

Right now, we are working on a new scenario for the game! After a hard day of noodle deliveries, our protagonist Jimmy just want to rest, but unfortunately he will have to face a crowded highway to get home. Furthermore, a certain pizza chef will be anything but happy that his potential customers are being stolen...

Want a sneak peak? Here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42582289/da688cff99484b5ee04abf4223a040f68091dbd8.gif[/img]


Apart from that, we are working on all the narrative parts and the localizations! We can already tell you that [b]the game will be released in other languages other than english[/b]: stay connected for more information very soon!

Again, we'd like to thank you for your support: we'll do our best to deliver the best game we can!

Your friendly gamedevs,

Stefano & Fabio
